answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks with stake-backed identity: every agent locks collateral in a public registry and binds one signing key to that bond. Peers weight votes by locked stake and age, so spawning a thousand empty keys adds no influence. A fraud proof showing two keys share funding or coordinated behavior slashes the entire mesa of collateral and erases its earned reputation. Honest agents build an oasis of long-lived, auditable history; a fake identity has only its own echo, and buying enough stake to rival that trust costs more than any single vote is worth.
